title: How Do Savings Groups Respond to Agricultural Shocks?
title_zh: 储蓄小组如何应对农业冲击？
title_primary: 储蓄小组如何应对农业冲击？
title_secondary: How Do Savings Groups Respond to Agricultural Shocks?
authors: G. F. van Hemert Daniël, Bert D'Espallier, Roy Mersland
official: 官方在线 2026-09-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Negative aggregate shocks lead to persistent rural poverty. Access to credit and insurance can help, but is often lacking. How do informal financial institutions, dependent on locally sourced capital, respond to shocks? We study the response of savings groups—locally run financial associations mostly embedded in rural agricultural communities—to aggregate shocks. We explore this by combining group‐level performance data for 9328 savings groups primarily in five sub‐Saharan African countries with local drought data. We use two‐way fixed‐effects and heterogeneity‐robust difference‐in‐differences analyses to assess how these informal financial groups respond to drought shocks. Groups mobilise credit during shocks by increasing the number of loans they provide. The counter‐cyclical credit response is concentrated among groups shocked in the later stages of their savings cycle, where accumulated capital permits additional lending, confirming a capital‐constraint prediction. The social fund, designed for idiosyncratic shocks, is not mobilised during droughts. We discuss implications for integrating informal savings groups into climate‐risk management strategies.
abstract_zh: 负向总体冲击会导致持续性的农村贫困。获得信贷和保险可能有所帮助，但往往难以实现。依赖本地资金来源的非正式金融机构如何应对冲击？我们研究了储蓄小组——主要嵌入农村农业社区、由地方运营的金融协会——对总体冲击的响应。我们通过将主要位于五个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的9328个储蓄小组的小组层面绩效数据与当地干旱数据相结合来探讨这一问题。我们使用双向固定效应和异质性稳健双重差分分析，评估这些非正式金融小组如何应对干旱冲击。小组在冲击期间通过增加所提供的贷款数量来动员信贷。这种逆周期信贷响应集中在其储蓄周期后期受到冲击的小组中，在这些小组中，积累的资本允许额外放贷，从而证实了资本约束预测。为异质性冲击而设计的社会基金在干旱期间并未被动员。我们讨论了将非正式储蓄小组纳入气候风险管理策略的含义。

title: From Skills to Occupations: Comparative Advantage and Cross-Country Income Differences

title_primary: 从技能到职业：比较优势与跨国收入差异
title_secondary: From Skills to Occupations: Comparative Advantage and Cross-Country Income Differences
authors: Charles Gottlieb, Jan Grobovsek, Alexander Monge-Naranjo, Fernanda Ortega, Dennis Snower 等
official: 官方在线 2025-09-08 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where workers of different skill groups sort into occupations by comparative advantage. Wages and employment depend on workers’ skill quality, occupation-specific country-embedded productivity, and occupational distortions. Using harmonized microdata for 50 countries, we infer these components from the model’s equilibrium conditions. Workers in rich countries exhibit higher skill quality and substantially greater productivity, especially in white-collar occupations. Human capital explains 52 percent of output-per-worker gaps, largely through the complementarity between skill composition and quality, and further amplified by technology choices biased toward skilled labor. Adopting the U.S. distribution of skill groups yields limited gains for poor countries without higher quality. Occupational distortions are more severe in low-income countries, reducing white-collar employment and raising wage premia, but with modest aggregate effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中不同技能群体的劳动者依据比较优势配置到不同职业。工资和就业取决于劳动者的技能质量、特定职业中嵌入国家的生产率以及职业扭曲。利用50个国家协调后的微观数据，我们从模型的均衡条件中推断出这些组成部分。富裕国家的劳动者表现出更高的技能质量，并且生产率显著更高，尤其是在白领职业中。人力资本解释了52%的人均产出差距，这主要通过技能构成与技能质量之间的互补性实现，并因偏向技能劳动的技术选择而进一步放大。在技能质量未提高的情况下，采用美国的技能群体分布对贫穷国家带来的收益有限。职业扭曲在低收入国家更为严重，降低了白领就业并提高了工资溢价，但对总体影响较为有限。

title: DP20634 Training in the Age of AI: A Theory of Career Viability
title_zh: 人工智能时代的培训：职业可行性理论
title_primary: 人工智能时代的培训：职业可行性理论

authors: Luis Garicano, Luis Rayo
official: 官方在线 2025-09-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Across the economy, juniors pay for training by doing menial tasks. AI now performs an increasing share of that work, putting the bargain at risk. We introduce AI into a dynamic career model with an automation threshold and possible complementarity for experts. The expertise leverage ratio, measuring the output of a fully-trained graduate relative to that of a novice who has just enough knowledge to outperform AI, governs the overall impact of the technology. Our central result is that careers are guaranteed viable, in the sense that they are at least as profitable as they were before the arrival of AI, when this ratio is above a critical threshold, specifically Euler's number e; in this case, training has a fixed duration and the training path is not at risk. Below the threshold, the senior's saleable knowledge shrinks and training compresses; in this case, advances in AI threaten wholesale career collapse.

title: Environmental conditions, innovation capacity, and the transition to agriculture

title_primary: 环境条件、创新能力与向农业的转型
title_secondary: Environmental conditions, innovation capacity, and the transition to agriculture
authors: Lothar Grall, Christian Haas, Karol Kempa, Jürgen Meckl
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The shift from foraging to agriculture, the Neolithic transition, is a key episode in human history with long-term effects on comparative development. This paper proposes the innovation and adaptive capacity of humans, rooted in physiological and cognitive attributes, as a hitherto neglected deep-rooted determinant of this transition. We develop an evolutionary growth theory based on insights from (evolutionary) biology and anthropology. The theory suggests that exposure to intergenerational variability in environmental conditions alters the evolutionarily optimal allocation of hunter-gatherers’ resources from offspring quantity to offspring quality. The resulting increase in human innovation and adaptive capacity increases the rate of technological progress and ultimately facilitates the adoption of agricultural practices. We test the model’s prediction using a novel cross-archaeological-site dataset covering early Neolithic settlements in Europe, Asia, and northern Africa. We instrument the innovation and adaptive capacity of hunter-gatherers with the intergenerational variability of environmental conditions long before the transition and find an economically significant effect on the timing of the transition to agriculture. Further analyses show that human adaptive capacity was an enabling factor for previously identified behavioural adjustments to changes in external conditions, ultimately translating into the successful adoption of agriculture. Hence, this paper establishes a new determinant of the early adoption of agriculture, which induced a head start in long-term comparative development.
abstract_zh: 从觅食向农业的转变，即新石器时代转型，是人类历史上的一个关键事件，对比较发展具有长期影响。本文提出，根植于生理和认知属性的人类创新能力与适应能力，是这一转型迄今被忽视的深层决定因素。我们基于（进化）生物学和人类学的洞见，构建了一种演化增长理论。该理论表明，暴露于环境条件的代际变异性，会改变狩猎采集者资源配置的进化最优方向，使其从后代数量转向后代质量。由此带来的人类创新能力与适应能力提升，提高了技术进步速度，并最终促进农业实践的采纳。我们使用一个涵盖欧洲、亚洲和北非早期新石器时代定居点的新型跨考古遗址数据集，检验了模型的预测。我们以转型前很久的环境条件代际变异性作为狩猎采集者创新能力与适应能力的工具变量，发现其对向农业转型的时间具有经济上显著的影响。进一步分析表明，人类适应能力是此前已识别的对外部条件变化作出行为调整的使能因素，并最终转化为对农业的成功采纳。因此，本文确立了早期采纳农业的一个新决定因素，而这一因素在长期比较发展中带来了先发优势。

title: The health burden of job strain: evidence from Europe
title_zh: 工作压力的健康负担：来自欧洲的证据
title_primary: 工作压力的健康负担：来自欧洲的证据
title_secondary: The health burden of job strain: evidence from Europe
authors: Petru Crudu, Giacomo Pasini
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how occupational stressors and job tasks over the life course are associated with health later in life. Using SHARE data and retrospective job histories for individuals across Europe, we construct career-long exposure to occupational stressors by linking 4-digit ISCO occupations to external measures of job demands. We find that physical job intensity, measured by the metabolic equivalent of task, is associated with worse later-life health, and this result remains stable across sensitivity analyses. Higher exposure is also associated with a greater incidence of some cardiovascular and respiratory diseases and with an earlier onset of several cardiovascular, metabolic, and respiratory conditions. We use detailed task information and a LASSO-based approach to identify the job tasks most strongly associated with poor health and to build a Job Strain Intensity index. This task-based framework offers a granular and scalable way to detect harmful dimensions of work and inform policy discussions.

title: Sabotage as Industrial Policy

title_primary: 破坏作为产业政策
title_secondary: Sabotage as Industrial Policy
authors: Jin Liu, Martin Rotemberg, Sharon Traiberman
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We characterise sabotage, exemplified by recent US policies concerning China’s semiconductor industry, as trade policy. For some (but not all) goods, completely destroying foreigners’ productivity increases domestic real income by shifting the location of production and improving the terms of trade. The gross benefit of sabotage can be summarised by a few sufficient statistics: trade and demand elasticities and import and production shares. The cost of sabotage is determined by countries’ relative unit labour costs for the sabotaged goods. We find important non-monotonicities: for semiconductors, partially sabotaging foreign production would lower US real income, while comprehensive sabotage would raise it.
abstract_zh: 我们将破坏行为——以近期美国针对中国半导体产业的政策为例——界定为一种贸易政策。对于某些（但并非所有）商品而言，完全摧毁外国的生产能力可通过改变生产区位和改善贸易条件来提高本国实际收入。破坏行为的总收益可由少数充分统计量来概括：贸易与需求弹性以及进口份额和生产份额。破坏行为的成本取决于各国在受破坏商品上的相对单位劳动成本。我们发现存在重要的非单调性：就半导体而言，部分破坏外国生产会降低美国实际收入，而全面破坏则会提高美国实际收入。

title: Do Teachers Boost Test Scores in Public High Schools in Delhi?
title_zh: 德里的公立高中教师能提高考试成绩吗？
title_primary: 德里的公立高中教师能提高考试成绩吗？
title_secondary: Do Teachers Boost Test Scores in Public High Schools in Delhi?
authors: Deepti Goel, Bidisha Barooah
source: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We measure teacher effects by their ability to raise test scores in high‐stakes examinations. We present estimates for value‐added teacher effects from public high schools , while prior work in developing countries has focused on primary and middle schools or private high schools. Our data come from 22 schools and represent the cohort of public‐school students in Delhi who took their end of grade 12 examinations in 2016. We estimate teacher effects using within‐student and across‐subject variation in test scores, and additionally account for contemporaneous student inputs. We find substantial variation in teacher quality that contradicts the perception that most public‐school teachers are ineffective: over the course of two years, namely grades 11 and 12, being assigned a one standard deviation better than average teacher from the same school moves a student at the median to the 63rd percentile of their cohort's test score distribution. Furthermore, being female is the only teacher attribute that positively predicts teacher effectiveness; training, experience, and personality traits are uncorrelated with teacher effectiveness. Lastly, we find low correlation between value‐added teacher effects and principals' ratings of teachers implying that principals' ratings cannot function as a proxy for value‐added estimates when deciding teacher compensation.
abstract_zh: 我们通过教师提高高风险考试成绩的能力来衡量教师效应。我们给出了公立高中教师增值效应的估计，而此前发展中国家的研究主要集中于小学、初中或私立高中。我们的数据来自22所学校，代表了德里公立学校2016年参加12年级末考试的学生队列。我们利用学生内部和跨学科的考试成绩变异来估计教师效应，并进一步考虑了同期学生投入。我们发现教师质量存在显著差异，这与大多数公立学校教师无效的认知相矛盾：在两年期间，即11年级和12年级，若被分配给一位比同校平均水平高出1个标准差的教师，会使处于中位数的学生升至其队列考试成绩分布的第63百分位。此外，女性是唯一能够正向预测教师有效性的教师属性；培训、经验和人格特质与教师有效性不相关。最后，我们发现增值教师效应与校长对教师的评分之间相关性较低，这意味着在决定教师薪酬时，校长评分不能作为增值估计的代理指标。

title: Immigration and local inflation: Evidence from US cities
title_zh: 移民与地方通胀：来自美国城市的证据
title_primary: 移民与地方通胀：来自美国城市的证据
title_secondary: Immigration and local inflation: Evidence from US cities
authors: Philip Barrett, Brandon Joel Tan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the impact of inward immigration on city-level inflation in the United States. We find that doubling the rate of immigration reduces inflation by about 0.1 to 0.2 percentage points. The disinflationary effect is concentrated in goods prices. Effects are larger for working-age immigrants, with suggestive but less precise evidence of stronger disinflationary effects from less-educated immigrants, especially in services. Housing markets respond differently: immigration increases local housing prices, with the largest effects for higher-education immigrants. Our results are jointly rationalized by a simple general equilibrium model where substitutability of capital and labor varies across industries but capital is fixed in the short run.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了美国境内移民流入对城市层面通货膨胀的影响。研究发现，移民率翻倍会使通货膨胀率下降约0.1至0.2个百分点。这一通缩效应主要集中在商品价格上。对于处于劳动年龄的移民，其影响更为显著；尽管证据尚不精确，但提示性结果表明，教育程度较低的移民，尤其是在服务业领域，可能带来更强的通缩效应。住房市场的反应则有所不同：移民推高了当地房价，其中对高学历移民的影响最为显著。我们的研究结果通过一个简单的通用均衡模型得到了统一解释，该模型假设资本与劳动的替代性在不同行业间存在差异，但短期内资本固定不变。

official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The classic literature argues that a large middle class is a prerequisite for economic development. Is this true when AI progress threatens to disrupt the labor market? On the one hand, uncertainty about the consequences can impede the passage of AI-friendly regulation: voters fear the prospect of losing when the uncertainty is resolved. On the other, granular information about reform consequences may reduce political support as well. In our model, a larger middle class hampers reform, compensatory redistribution is most politically effective when its welfare justification is weakest, and AI regulatory sandboxes encounter resistance because new information undermines reform coalitions.

title: Netflix and Chilling Effect? The Impact of Streaming Video Licenses on Paid Digital Downloads
title_zh: 奈飞与寒蝉效应？流媒体视频许可对付费数字下载的影响
title_primary: 奈飞与寒蝉效应？流媒体视频许可对付费数字下载的影响

authors: Brett Danaher, Shahryar Doosti
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Digital distribution has expanded monetization opportunities for media firms, but it also introduces complex tradeoffs across channels. A central challenge for studios and networks is negotiating fixed-fee licensing deals with bundled subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) platforms like Netflix, whose flat-rate access model may cannibalize à la carte sales on transactional platforms such as iTunes. We exploit the natural experiment of Netflix’s launch in Australia to estimate the causal effect of licensing a film to the service on its digital sales. On average, licensing reduces à la carte downloads by 52.5%, with effects that persist even after titles are removed from Netflix – evidence that temporary bundling can have durable effects on competing transactional channels. Crucially, we show that this treatment effect is heterogeneous: the direction and magnitude of the effect vary systematically with a film’s à la carte price and its latent demand. Lower-priced titles exhibit positive treatment effects following Netflix inclusion while higher-priced titles experience substantial declines, consistent with a framework in which subscriber substitution and cross-segment exposure operate in opposite directions and are differently moderated by the à la carte price. Our findings offer rare revealed-preference evidence on how SVOD bundling interacts with underlying demand, addressing classic questions in industrial organization around bundling and channel conflict.
abstract_zh: 数字发行扩大了媒体公司的变现机会，但也带来了跨渠道的复杂权衡。制片厂和电视网络面临的一个核心挑战是如何与Netflix等捆绑式订阅视频点播（SVOD）平台谈判固定费用许可协议，因为这类平台的包月访问模式可能会蚕食iTunes等交易型平台上的单点销售。我们利用Netflix在澳大利亚上线的自然实验，估计将电影授权给该服务对其数字销售的因果效应。平均而言，授权使单点下载量减少52.5%，且这一效应在影片从Netflix下架后依然持续——这表明临时捆绑可能对竞争性交易渠道产生持久影响。关键在于，我们证明这一处理效应具有异质性：效应的方向和大小随影片的单点价格及其潜在需求系统性变化。价格较低的影片在纳入Netflix后呈现正向处理效应，而价格较高的影片则出现显著下滑，这与一个框架相一致，即订阅者替代和跨细分市场曝光以相反方向发挥作用，并受到单点价格的不同调节。我们的发现提供了罕见的显示性偏好证据，说明SVOD捆绑如何与潜在需求相互作用，回应了产业组织领域关于捆绑和渠道冲突的经典问题。

title: Outside Options and Labor Supply: Evidence from the Gig Economy
title_zh: 外部选择与劳动力供给：来自零工经济的证据

official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use randomized pay experiments among Uber drivers, paired with a natural experiment in access to a competitor, to examine how outside options shape labor supply to the firm. When hours are flexible, the firm-specific labor supply elasticity combines a market-hours component and a firm-substitution component. Access to a single competing platform nearly doubles drivers’ firm-specific elasticity and cuts the implied monopsony markdown from 68% to about 50%. The same experiments identify sex differences: women are about twice as elastic to the market as men, yet no less elastic to their employer.

abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific ("residual") labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm's labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.
abstract_zh: 近年来，关于劳动力市场不完全竞争的文献迅速增多。本文为该领域提供了一份指南，重点将企业特定（“剩余”）劳动力供给弹性作为企业劳动力市场势力的定义。我们提出了一个一般性框架，展示这一弹性如何涵盖三种被广泛研究的买方垄断势力来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，强调了可能存在的异质性来源。我们指出，由于企业工资设定实践的多样性，从加价率推断弹性（反之亦然）较为困难，并通过买方垄断与效率工资之间的相互作用来说明这一点。我们讨论了反垄断、劳动力市场监管、移民和宏观经济学中的政策问题如何与买方垄断相互作用，并最后列出未来研究的几个领域。

abstract: This study assesses how weather‐year‐dependent sheep and crop management tactics affect farm profitability and farm system greenhouse gas emissions in the central Great Southern region in Australia. To investigate the impact of farmers' tactical decisions on farm profit and emissions, a whole farm optimisation model known as the Australian Farm Optimisation Model is employed. The model describes a typical mixed enterprise farm, the weather‐year variation that underpins the farm system and the plethora of strategic and tactical management options available to the farm manager. Modelling results reveal that utilising all tactical management options increases expected farm profit by 26% and expected emissions increase by 11%; however, the emissions intensity with respect to farm profit is reduced. Access to tactical options can greatly improve profits and emissions intensity in particular types of weather‐years. Emission and profit outcomes are a combination of direct effects of individual tactics and the strategic structural shifts they trigger across the whole farm (enterprise mix, stocking rate), underscoring the value of whole‐farm optimisation models for guiding management and policy. The modelling results also reveal that assessing the value and emission impact of tactics depends on the other tactics already available to the farm manager. This indicates the need for whole farm system analysis if the stacking or bundling of tactical options in agricultural systems is to be properly understood and estimated.

abstract: Addressing the massive test score gaps between rich and poor countries will require programs that are both high-impact and scalable. This study uses the results of a randomized controlled trial in low-fee private schools in Ghana to study a program that meets both needs. The Tools for Foundational Learning Improvement program increased test scores by 0.5 standard deviation after just nine months of intervention. A machine learning method decomposes the effects by predicted test scores if the students did not receive the treatment, and the findings show that the gains were larger for weaker students. Moreover, the program’s impacts scale roughly linearly with time compared to a shorter-term, smaller-scale pilot randomized controlled trial. The program’s developers used generative artificial intelligence to accelerate lesson plan development and adaptation to new settings. An observational pilot test of this adaptation in Uganda yielded comparable results to those of this study’s randomized controlled trial. The study developed a model in which basic skills constrain the development of advanced skills, which predicts the pattern of effects observed across early reading capabilities, and it makes forecasts about the future impacts of the program as it continues into second grade.

abstract: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic life-cycle model to quantify why households save and work. The model incorporates multiple sources of risk—health, marital status, wages, medical expenses, and mortality—as well as endogenous labor supply and human capital accumulation, retirement, and bequest motives at the death of the first and last household member. We estimate it using PSID and HRS data for the 1941–1945 cohort via the Method of Simulated Moments. Eliminating bequest motives reduces aggregate wealth by 23.8% and labor earnings by 1.2%; removing medical expenses lowers them by 13.1% and 0.7%. Wage risk is crucial for early-life saving: its removal reduces wealth by 10.4% but raises earnings by 2.3%. Eliminating marriage and divorce dynamics leads couples—numerous and wealthier—to save and work slightly less, and singles—fewer and poorer—to save and work considerably more. These effects largely offset in the aggregate. Removing all saving motives beyond retirement needs and lifespan uncertainty lowers wealth by 56.9% and earnings by 2.7%. These findings show that capturing multiple risks and behavioral margins jointly is essential to understanding household saving and labor supply.

abstract: Using Measure 114’s narrow passage in Oregon as a natural experiment, we study how new gun regulations affect firearm demand. Background checks, a proxy for demand, rose 13.9% in anticipation of the referendum and surged 157% immediately following the election. abstract: The paper shows that the conversion from national currency bank notes to hard-ECU notes is promoted by the provision of an implicit and free currency call option. This wealth effect is caused by the devaluation-proof definition of this currency. Nevertheless, additional transactions and information costs would keep the demand for hard-ECUs very limited. Because of such externalities the market does not lead to a Pareto-efficient arrangement for the European monetary order. At best the hard-ECU would out-compete currencies of EC countries with above-average inflation rates, while national currencies would remain in use in the other EC countries. In addition, the competition process is distorted by the subsidy character of the implicit option. The scheme is intended to enhance monetary stability in Europe, but the need for such an additional nominal anchor is not clear, nor is any reason why the Hard-ECU Bank should have an an extremely strong stability orientation. Moreover, a deliberate interest rate policy of the HEB, which would be required to discipline national central banks, conflicts with the main target of using the market as an exploratory device for identifying an optimum European monetary order.

abstract: The CHIPS and Science Act, enacted in August 2022, is a key element of the revival of U.S. industrial policy. We examine the short-term employment effects of the act. Drawing on quarterly industry-by-county data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), we implement two county-level difference-in-difference designs, the first comparing counties with pre-existing semiconductor facilities to other counties with high-tech industries and the second comparing counties with semiconductor fabrication facilities (which were targeted for the bulk of the CHIPS funding) to counties with non-fabrication semiconductor facilities. Using both approaches, we find robust, positive employment impacts in affected counties. The effects began at the time of the passage in the Senate of a precursor bill, in anticipation of the signing of the CHIPS Act. Our preferred estimates suggest an increase of 110 jobs per affected county in the first design and 180 jobs per affected county in the second design. We also find robust positive impacts on local construction employment. Evidence on total employment and GDP at the county level, as well as on employment in upstream input sectors, is mixed. Simple back-of-the-envelope calculations (which come with caveats) suggest national direct employment effects of approximately 15, 000-16, 000 jobs in the core semiconductor sector and indirect effects of 28, 000-35, 000 jobs in related sectors.
abstract_zh: 2022年8月颁布的《芯片与科学法案》是美国产业政策复兴的关键举措。本文考察该法案的短期就业效应。基于《季度就业与工资普查》（QCEW）提供的行业-县季度数据，我们采用两种县级双重差分设计：第一种比较拥有现有半导体设施的县与其他拥有高科技产业的县；第二种比较拥有半导体制造设施（《芯片法案》资金主要投向对象）的县与拥有非制造类半导体设施的县。两种方法均发现受影响县出现稳健的正向就业效应。该效应始于参议院通过预算法案之时，早于《芯片法案》正式签署。我们的首选估计显示，第一种设计中每个受影响县新增110个就业岗位，第二种设计中每个受影响县新增180个就业岗位。我们还发现对当地建筑业就业产生稳健的正向影响。县级总就业与GDP数据，以及上游投入部门就业数据的证据则呈现混合特征。基于简单粗略估算（需注意局限性）表明，核心半导体部门全国直接就业效应约为15,000-16,000个岗位，相关行业间接就业效应为28,000-35,000个岗位。

abstract: Evidence is mixed on whether central banks can influence exchange rates simply by talking about them. This column explores this question by analysing more than two decades of ECB communications. The authors find that exchange rate communication has only limited effects on the euro exchange rate, and any effects that do emerge tend to disappear quickly. This stands in contrast with monetary policy communication, which is a major driver of exchange rate movements. Financial markets seem to pay much more attention to what central banks do or say about monetary policy than to what they say about exchange rates.
abstract_zh: 关于央行能否仅通过口头干预影响汇率，现有证据结论不一。本文通过分析欧洲央行二十余年的沟通记录探讨这一问题。作者发现，汇率沟通对欧元汇率的影响十分有限，且任何显现出的效应往往迅速消退。这与货币政策沟通形成鲜明对比——后者才是汇率波动的主要驱动因素。金融市场似乎更关注央行在货币政策上的行动或言论，而非其对汇率的表态。

abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.

abstract: Since the launch of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), China and partner economies have promoted economic growth through close cooperation and mutual benefit. Nevertheless, critics argue that BRI projects have increased debt burdens in participating countries, particularly developing economies, potentially leading to a so called ‘debt trap’. Treating BRI participants as the treatment group and nonparticipants as the control group, this paper employs a difference-in-differences framework to estimate the BRI’s impact on sovereign debt risk and to identify the transmission channels. We find that the BRI significantly reduces debt risk among participating countries. Further mechanism analysis reveals that this effect operates not only through economic channels, specifically infrastructure and export trade, but also through political channels, political mutual trust and government governance. Moreover, the debt-mitigating effect is heterogeneous, with stronger impacts observed in countries characterized by higher income, greater financial development, and lower trade openness. These findings shed light on the nexus between geoeconomic cooperation and sovereign debt dynamics.

abstract: This paper investigates the convergence and subsequent divergence of labor productivity between the U.S. and Europe through a quantitative general equilibrium framework that integrates endogenous changes in employment shares as a function of exogenous and unbalanced labor productivity growth rates across sectors. We calibrate our model to the U.S. and test it against Europe from 1970 to 2019. Our model accurately captures structural transformation and aggregate labor productivity paths, as well as the timing of Europe’s transition from convergence to divergence relative to the U.S. Leveraging a set of numerical experiments, we find that the reallocation of labor toward less productive sectors in response to sectoral productivity changes hinders the potential effects that the productivity growth in market services may have on the aggregate labor productivity: The heterogeneous productivity observed within services brings forth a Baumol cost disease whereby productive sectors gain less employment share than their productivity growth would imply under constant shares, despite their strong income effects. An extended version of our model that accounts for international trade suggests that it is implausible for Europe to export its way out of the aggregate stagnation unleashed by labor reallocation toward unproductive sectors.

abstract: Countries borrow in dollars because dollar debt markets are deep and liquid. This paper develops a theory of when that dominance becomes fragile because countries have inherited dollar liabilities but increasingly earn yuan-linked revenues. In the model, countries begin with dollar-denominated sovereign debt. Geopolitical fragmentation raises their yuan revenue share through two channels: higher trade barriers with dollar-linked markets shift exports toward yuan-linked markets, and higher costs of using dollars in that trade make yuan settlement more attractive. Governments then face a choice: repay dollar debt using revenues that are less dollar-linked, default, or restructure into yuan. The paper identifies a liquidity spillover from restructuring: dollar-to-yuan restructurings deepen yuan debt markets, lowering refinancing costs and encouraging additional restructurings. The model shows when fragmentation produces limited restructuring and when it triggers a self-reinforcing shift from dollar debt to yuan debt. A cascade requires the liquidity feedback from yuan restructuring to be stronger than the dispersion in countries’ yuan revenue exposure.
abstract_zh: 各国以美元借贷，是因为美元债务市场深度大、流动性强。本文构建了一个理论，探讨当各国继承美元负债但收入日益与人民币挂钩时，这种主导地位何时会变得脆弱。在模型中，各国最初持有以美元计价的主权债务。地缘政治碎片化通过两个渠道提高其人民币收入份额：与美元挂钩市场的贸易壁垒提高，促使出口转向人民币挂钩市场；以及在该贸易中使用美元的成本上升，使人民币结算更具吸引力。政府随后面临选择：用与美元关联度较低的收入偿还美元债务、违约，或重组为人民币债务。本文识别出重组带来的流动性溢出效应：美元转人民币的重组深化了人民币债务市场，降低了再融资成本，并鼓励更多重组。模型展示了碎片化何时导致有限的重组，以及何时触发从美元债务向人民币债务的自我强化转变。这种级联效应需要人民币重组的流动性反馈强于各国人民币收入敞口的分散程度。

abstract: The Head Start program, launched in 1965 and targeted to children from disadvantaged backgrounds, remains the largest early childhood care and education (ECE) program in the United States and the only one deployed at the federal level. As such, the Head Start literature spans several decades and now allows for synthesis of findings from different contexts, time periods, and research designs. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the rigorous evidence measuring Head Start’s effects on children, their families, and society. The focus is on how (1) the contrast between program and counterfactual conditions, (2) takeup of the program among eligible populations, and (3) treatment–effect heterogeneity inform interpretation and applicability of key findings. The paper presents implications of the evidence for the modern-day Head Start program and an adjacent, policy-relevant research agenda.
abstract_zh: 启智计划”始于1965年，面向弱势背景儿童，至今仍是美国规模最大的早期儿童保育与教育项目，也是唯一由联邦层面部署的项目。因此，关于“启智计划”的研究文献跨越数十年，如今已能综合不同情境、时期和研究设计的发现。本文对衡量“启智计划”对儿童、家庭及社会影响的严谨证据进行了全面评估，重点探讨以下三点如何影响关键发现的解读与适用性：（1）项目条件与反事实条件之间的对比；（2）合格人群的项目参与率；（3）处理效应的异质性。本文还阐述了这些证据对当代“启智计划”的启示，并提出了与之相关的政策研究方向。

abstract: This article analyzes the link between business cycles synchronization and trade integration using panel data for 15 West African countries from 2000 to 2020. Business cycles synchronization is a key requirement from the standpoint of establishing a common currency by 2027. We add to the body of literature by considering intra-industry trade and accounting for the effect of fiscal, monetary and exchange rate policies. Our results suggest that trade intensity is positively related to the synchronization of business cycles in West Africa. However, intra-industry trade is not the major factor explaining the co-movements of the business cycles. Indeed, our findings indicate that the enhancement of fiscal, monetary, and exchange rate coordination fosters the synchronization of business cycles. The study’s results have relevant policy implications for the proposed formation of a West African currency union.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2000年至2020年15个西非国家的面板数据，分析了商业周期同步性与贸易一体化之间的联系。商业周期同步性是到2027年建立共同货币的关键要求。我们通过考虑产业内贸易并纳入财政、货币及汇率政策的影响，为现有文献做出了贡献。研究结果表明，在西非，贸易强度与商业周期同步性呈正相关。然而，产业内贸易并非解释商业周期共同变动的主要因素。实际上，我们的发现表明，加强财政、货币及汇率政策的协调有助于促进商业周期的同步性。该研究结果对拟议中的西非货币联盟形成具有重要的政策启示。

title: Digital literacy training to promote diffusion of digital agricultural tools to smallholder farmers: evidence from a randomized intervention in Egypt

authors: Fatma Abdelaziz, Kibrom A. Abay
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite growing enthusiasm about the potential of digital innovations to transform agrifood systems, adoption among smallholder farmers in Africa remains low and heterogeneous. While the proliferation of digital tools targeting smallholder farmers is encouraging, the vast majority remain at pilot stages, facing barriers such as limited awareness among farmer, digital illiteracy, usability challenges, and low trust among farmers. This paper evaluates alternative digital literacy interventions designed to address these demand-side barriers and enhance smallholder farmers’ knowledge, utilization, trust, and uptake of two Egyptian mobile apps offering marketing, advisory, and input delivery services. Following a Training of Trainers (TOT) model, we designed and implemented a randomized controlled trial to test three variants of digital literacy training: standard classroom-based digital literacy training (T1), digital training complemented (preceded) by a video-based play (T2), digital training complemented (preceded) by a live community play (T3), and a control group (C). We find that the different variants of digital training led to statistically significant increases in uptake and utilization of digital tools. Specifically, the standard digital training alone increased uptake by 20 percentage points and utilization by 18 percentage points. The interventions also improved farmers’ trust in digital tools by 8–13 percentage points. Surprisingly, for some outcomes, the digital literacy training alone outperformed the combined approaches that incorporated edutainment nudges. We explore possible explanations, including group size effects and social influence dynamics during the plays. We also document heterogeneity in the impact of these interventions across farmers’ gender and age. Our findings offer insights into designing cost-effective, scalable interventions that build digital capabilities and trust among smallholder farmers, while cautioning against assuming edutainment always strengthens adoption outcomes.
abstract_zh: 尽管数字创新在改造农业食品系统方面的潜力日益受到关注，但非洲小农户的采纳率仍然较低且存在异质性。尽管针对小农户的数字工具数量激增令人鼓舞，但绝大多数仍处于试点阶段，面临诸如农民认知有限、数字素养不足、可用性挑战以及农民信任度低等障碍。本文评估了旨在解决这些需求侧障碍并提升小农户对两款埃及移动应用的知识、使用、信任及采纳情况的替代性数字素养干预措施，这两款应用提供营销、咨询和投入品配送服务。遵循培训培训者（TOT）模式，我们设计并实施了一项随机对照试验，测试三种数字素养培训变体：标准课堂式数字素养培训（T1）、辅以（前置）视频剧情的数字培训（T2）、辅以（前置）现场社区剧情的数字培训（T3），以及对照组（C）。我们发现，不同变体的数字培训均显著提高了数字工具的采纳和使用率。具体而言，仅标准数字培训就将采纳率提高了20个百分点，使用率提高了18个百分点。干预措施还将农民对数字工具的信任度提高了8至13个百分点。令人意外的是，在某些结果上，仅数字素养培训的表现优于结合了寓教于乐助推手段的综合方法。我们探讨了可能的解释，包括群体规模效应和剧情表演期间的社会影响动态。我们还记录了这些干预措施在农民性别和年龄上的影响异质性。我们的发现为设计具有成本效益、可扩展的干预措施提供了见解，这些措施能够建立小农户的数字能力和信任，同时提醒人们不要假设寓教于乐总能增强采纳结果。

official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Both the rate and timing of crop fertilizer application play an important role in agricultural productivity. However, inefficient fertilizer use can significantly increase production costs, water pollution, and greenhouse gas emissions. To capture both the spatial heterogeneity and dynamic nature of this problem, we develop a multi-stage network production model, which links the sequential stages of crop growth within the overall crop production process. We use this framework to estimate nitrogen fertilizer application inefficiency and to determine the optimal rate and timing of fertilizer application. We apply this framework to wheat production at the field scale, using an agronomic simulation model calibrated to experimental data from Australia. Our results indicate that it is optimal to reduce the overall fertilizer application rate and to move away from the current practice of front-loading fertilizer in the initial stages of crop growth toward the intermediate stages. This can be achieved without compromising yields while also reducing nutrient losses.
abstract_zh: 作物施肥的速率与时机对农业生产率均具有重要影响。然而，低效的施肥使用可能显著增加生产成本、水污染及温室气体排放。为捕捉该问题的空间异质性与动态特性，我们构建了一个多阶段网络生产模型，该模型将作物生长过程中的连续阶段与整体作物生产过程相衔接。我们利用此框架评估氮肥施用效率，并确定施肥的最优速率与时机。我们将该框架应用于田间尺度的小麦生产，采用基于澳大利亚实验数据校准的农艺模拟模型。结果表明，最优策略是降低总体施肥速率，并摒弃当前在作物生长初期集中施肥的做法，转而将施肥重点移至生长中期阶段。这一调整可在不牺牲产量的同时减少养分损失。

authors: Takuto Kaneko, David Lowing, Satoshi Nakada

abstract: In cooperative games with communication networks, it is typically assumed that two players can communicate whenever there is a connecting path between them, regardless of its length. We relax this assumption by introducing a new concept, k -boundedness, which sets an upper bound on the length of admissible communication paths. Building on this idea, we define a restriction operator for feasible coalitions in communication games, which leads to a new solution concept extending the Myerson value. Our first main contribution is an axiomatic characterization of this solution within the class of games with communication networks. The characterization combines the classical Fairness axiom with new axioms capturing the effect of k -boundedness constraints on cooperative possibilities. We then investigate the feasible coalition structures that arise under arbitrary k -boundedness constraints, which we term feasible communication structures. Within this alternative framework, we provide another axiomatic characterization of our solution concept.
abstract_zh: 在具有通信网络的合作博弈中，通常假设只要两个玩家之间存在连接路径，无论其长度如何，他们就能进行通信。我们通过引入一个新概念——k-有界性，放宽了这一假设，该概念为可允许的通信路径长度设定了上限。基于此思想，我们为通信博弈中的可行联盟定义了一个限制算子，从而引出一个扩展了Myerson值的新解概念。我们的第一个主要贡献是在具有通信网络的博弈类别中，对该解进行了公理化刻画。该刻画将经典的公平性公理与捕捉k-有界性约束对合作可能性影响的新公理相结合。随后，我们研究了在任意k-有界性约束下产生的可行联盟结构，称之为可行通信结构。在此替代框架内，我们为我们的解概念提供了另一种公理化刻画。
